name: unslop-writing
description: Jev-based contextual cliché review for substantial edited copy and first-person final prose.
notes: Uses TypeSafe by default or an HTTPS JEV_API_URL; TypeSafe requires an API key.
Uses 38 example-based cliché categories with no regex judgment or fallback; service failures allow continuation.
PostToolUse checks added text from apply_patch, Edit, and Write tools.
Stop checks the final assistant message and allows at most one continuation.
Stop intentionally skips short, third-person, and code-heavy responses.
